title: Nuevo Laredo Opens Registration for 2026 Christmas Parade on December 12
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo has opened free registration for its 2026 Christmas Parade, set for Saturday, December 12 at 6 p.m. Registration is open at the Tourism Office through Tuesday, December 8.
content:
The municipal government of Nuevo Laredo has opened free registration for the 2026 Christmas Parade, set for Saturday, December 12 at 6:00 p.m., according to the Oficina de Corresponsales news agency.

The parade is organized by the municipal government through the Secretariat of Economic Development. Businesses, institutions, groups, and residents are invited to take part with floats, trailers, trucks, and razers decorated with Christmas themes.

Participants may choose their own concept and use Christmas trees, gingerbread cookies, gift boxes, candy, snowmen, elves, reindeer, Santa Claus, and candy canes, among other decorations. Organizers encourage the use of recycled materials, headbands, and festive hats, so elaborate costumes or costly productions are not required, the report said.

Groups may include choreography and Christmas music, with each group providing its own sound vehicle. Christmas lighting on the vehicles and participants is recommended, and every unit must carry lighting and a fire extinguisher for safety.

Vehicles may be no taller than four meters, and platforms must carry a T-shaped structure no taller than 4.10 meters. Alcohol consumption is strictly prohibited during the parade, and trailers must present a current federal license, while other drivers need a valid driver's license and vehicle registration.

Registration is free at the Tourism Office, located at Matamoros #308 Altos in the former Longoria Bank building, from 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. The deadline to register is Tuesday, December 8.

Source: Oficina de Corresponsales, November 24, 2026.
